18017.horarioRegulado: City centre: Monday to Saturday, from 09:00 to 14:00, throughout the year. Seafront promenades: for 10 days during Easter, from the Friday before Palm Sunday to Easter Sunday, and from 1 July to 31 August, every day from 11:00 to 15:00 and from 19:00 to 22:00.
18017.condicionesPmr: You may park free of charge and without a time limit in the regulated parking zone. You only need to display the disabled parking card clearly. You do not need to obtain a ticket.
18017.observaciones: Always respect reserved bays, driveways, parking prohibitions and the signs on each street.
